title: AudioMeterScale
description: Canonical scale descriptor for the rlvgl audio-meters initiative. See docs/audio-meters/00-concepts.md §6 and §8. One file per scale under assets/audio-meters/scales/.

id.description: Unique identifier. Lowercase snake_case. MUST match filename stem.

label_units.description: Human-readable units shown next to numeric labels (e.g. dBVU, dBFS, LUFS).

range_db.description: Visible value range. Both endpoints are in the same domain as label_units (display-time, after calibration_default if present).

pivot.description: Reference point (alignment level). Maps a labelled scale position to its dBFS equivalent so the meter can be driven by the dBFS-domain ballistic state.

label.description: Display text at the pivot tick (e.g. "0", "4").

input_dbfs.description: dBFS sample value that should produce a reading at the pivot. e.g. -20 for vu_broadcast.

calibration_default.description: Optional default display-time additive offset applied to dBFS readings before label rendering. Skins MAY override.

to.description: Target display unit (e.g. dBu, dBV, dBSPL). Free-form; widgets render this verbatim if no override.

offset_db.description: Added to the dBFS-domain reading: display = dbfs + offset_db.

majors.description: Major-tick positions, in the same domain as range_db. SHOULD include both endpoints.

minors_per_major_division.description: Number of minor ticks between each pair of consecutive majors. 0 means no minor ticks.

labels.description: Optional label override map. Keys are stringified major-tick positions (e.g. "-20"); values are display strings. Majors without an entry render numeric.

zones.description: Colour-zone definition. Zones SHOULD partition range_db without gaps (the validator warns on overlaps or holes). Order is bottom-to-top.

color.description: MeterColor identifier (concepts §7). Skin maps identifier to RGB.

compatible_ballistics.description: Ballistic variants this scale is conventionally paired with (concepts §5). Advisory — skins MAY pair any ballistic with any scale; validator warns on advisory crossings.
